# ScottSearch 0.1.5 — complete startup indexing fix

> **Superseded by 0.1.6.** This version prevents the startup event storm, but
> still rebuilds the memory-only lexical index after every plugin start. Use
> 0.1.6 for persistent, changed-files-only warm startup.

This human-testing patch completes the fix for a beta report that Obsidian
could appear to hang on **Loading workspace** while ScottSearch was enabled.
It supersedes 0.1.4: a final audit found that Obsidian metadata-cache events
could still enqueue one note read per event before the deferred full rebuild.

## Fixed

- Workspace readiness schedules automatic indexing after a five-second grace
  period instead of starting full-vault reads inside the callback.
- Metadata-cache events received before or during the first full rebuild are
  coalesced by note path instead of launching thousands of parallel timers.
- The full rebuild absorbs events it already covered and replays only changes
  that arrived after a note's pass, preserving incremental correctness.
- Opening or using ScottSearch starts indexing immediately.
- Lexical indexing reads at most four notes concurrently and yields between
  batches.
- Explicit rebuilds cancel deferred startup work, pending incremental timers,
  and pending semantic refresh timers before taking a fresh snapshot.
- Disabling or unloading the plugin cancels deferred startup work.
- Deleted files are rejected before a stale queued read.

Automated lifecycle tests cover deferral, explicit start, unload cancellation,
startup-event coalescing, covered-versus-later changes, deletion, batch
concurrency, yielding, and superseded rebuilds. Real Obsidian startup timing
remains part of the public human beta; this release does not claim a device or
private-vault result that was not measured.

## Privacy and compatibility

The patch changes only how local indexing work is scheduled and coalesced. It
adds no network request, telemetry, or note mutation. Optional Ollama behavior
is unchanged, and unreleased on-device experiments remain excluded from the
public bundle.

ScottSearch supports Obsidian 1.7.2 or later on macOS, Windows, Linux, iPhone,
iPad, and Android. This remains a pre-release for human testing rather than a
stable Community-directory submission.

## Install or update

BRAT users can update ScottSearch normally. For a manual installation,
download `scottsearch-0.1.5.zip` below, unzip it, place the enclosed
`scottsearch` folder inside `<vault>/.obsidian/plugins/`, restart Obsidian, and
enable ScottSearch under **Settings → Community plugins**.

Please retry startup and submit sanitized results through the
[friendly beta form](https://github.com/c4g-john/scottsearch-for-obsidian/issues/new?template=beta_test_report.yml).
Do not include private note text, paths, or credentials in public reports.

To roll back, reinstall 0.1.3 from its release page. Neither update nor rollback
deletes notes. Version 0.1.4 remains available as superseded release history.
